_source: Generated by backend/scripts/calibrate_procedural.py from the Congressional Research Service's policy areas on the cached sponsored-legislation lists of a production snapshot: Commemorations is procedural, an area app/data/crs_policy_areas.json maps to another category is not, mixed areas left out. threshold: the grid point whose precision's exact lower 95% bound is highest on half the labels (split by a hash of the title), used only when that bound is at least 0.8, else null (the seed check never fires); held_out scores the other half.
